crossRefs.note: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

translations.web: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
translations.bsb: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.
translations.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
translations.asv: And when ye see a south wind blowing, ye say, There will be a scorching heat; and it cometh to pass.
